evidence.notes: NRTL property package (ethanol-water is highly non-ideal, forms a minimum-boiling azeotrope; Peng-Robinson would not capture this polar-mixture behavior). Built a single bubble-point stream (vapor_fraction=0, P=101325 Pa) for Ethanol/Water and swept mole_fraction.Ethanol over 0.5-0.95, then refined twice (coarse -> 0.855-0.9 -> 0.862-0.878) to locate the minimum of the T_K vs x curve. Minimum found at x_EtOH=0.868, T=351.530 K; curve is very flat near the minimum (<0.002 K variation over 0.862-0.878), confirmed by a direct solve at that composition. Matches the known literature azeotrope (~89 mol% EtOH, ~351.4 K) within the fidelity of DWSIM's default NRTL binary parameters.

Two standalone feed streams at 101325 Pa, 50/50 mol% ethanol/water, NRTL property package. S_bubble specified at vapor_fraction=0 gives T_bubble; S_dew at vapor_fraction=1 gives T_dew. Both solves ok=true, no units so no balance residuals beyond the single-stream flash itself.

20-stage distillation_column (condenser=stage1), feed stage 10, R=1.5, bottoms=60 mol/s, top P=101325 Pa, dP=0; property package NRTL chosen for methanol-water (strongly polar, non-ideal, H-bonding mixture). mass_rel_err=7.4e-7, compound_max_rel_err=3.1e-6, energy_rel_err=1.1e-12. Qc/Qr read from Col1 energy_streams_kW (both positive magnitudes, DWSIM convention).

NRTL property package (polar, non-ideal methanol-water system). Separator Flash fed at 355 K/101325 Pa with feed composition 40/60 mol% MeOH/water, 100 mol/s. Mass_rel_err ~4.7e-6, energy_rel_err ~4.7e-6, compound_max_rel_err ~2.0e-5.
